# namespace_id_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a short-lived signed OIDC ID token for workload identity federation using Namespace Cloud tenant credentials. The token is available only in-memory during Terraform operations and is not persisted to state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

ephemeral "namespace_id_token" "aws_federation" {
  audience = "https://iam.amazonaws.com/oidc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) Intended recipient audience URI or identifier for the issued OIDC ID token.

### Read-Only

- `id_token` (String, Sensitive) Issued short-lived signed OIDC ID token.
